lines: Kabir trains seven days a week.
Rest days are for people who don't want it enough.
Week three: he's lifting less than in week one.
Obviously not enough training. So he adds an eighth day. Somehow.
The workout breaks the muscle down. It grows back stronger while you rest.
No rest, no rebuilding. Just breaking.
So rest days aren't lazy. They're the part where you actually get stronger.
Train hard. Then let it build. Two rest days a week.
Kabir rests on purpose now. And lifts more.
Send this to the friend who trained through a fever.
How many rest days do you take?
